old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a black griddle on a speckled countertop. Two irregularly shaped pancakes are cooking on the griddle, their surfaces dotted with bubbles indicating they are in the process of being cooked. The pancakes appear to be of different sizes and shapes. The griddle is positioned on a stand with wheels, allowing for easy movement. In the background, part of a kitchen appliance is visible, though its type is not clear. The scene is lit, highlighting the texture of the pancakes and the speckled pattern of the countertop. The bubbles on the pancakes visibly change and pop over time, indicating an active cooking process.

Two round, flat pancakes are cooking on the griddle, their surfaces dotted with bubbles indicating they are in the process of being cooked. The pancakes appear to be of a similar size and shape, suggesting they might be made from the same batter. The griddle is positioned on a stand with wheels, allowing for easy movement. In the background, part of a kitchen appliance, possibly a coffee maker or a toaster, is visible, along with a white cup placed on the counter. The lighting in the scene is bright, highlighting the texture of the pancakes and the speckled pattern of the countertop. There are no significant changes or movements throughout the video; it focuses solely on the cooking process of the pancakes.
caption: The video captures a black rectangular drip tray on a speckled dark countertop beneath a dark metallic appliance body, with white cups in the upper-right background. Two separate clusters of pale foam sit on the tray, one toward the lower-left and one toward the upper-right, alongside a small wet smear near the tray's top edge. Throughout, the clusters hold their positions on the surface rather than sliding across it. Within each cluster the foam lattice continuously reshapes as individual bubbles pop and reform, so the internal pattern changes while the overall footprint stays roughly the same. The wet smear near the top edge persists unchanged. The camera framing drifts slightly, shifting the tray a few pixels relative to the edges and gradually revealing marginally more of the white cups. No new foam is dispensed and no wiping occurs, leaving both clusters still present.
